gold.statement: The production deployment region is eu-west-2.
The production checkout timeout is 30 seconds.

cases.design: An early decision is explicitly replaced by a later authoritative decision. The visible test accepts either value; the hidden checker requires the later one. The stale action is the earlier value.
cases.goldShape: decision, later sourceRef, supersedesFactId pointing at the early decision
mustCertify: early passes visible and fails hidden

cases.design: A dependency or approach is explicitly rejected in the history. The workspace is functional without it. The visible test checks behaviour; the hidden checker rejects the forbidden import or call.
cases.goldShape: rejected-approach, tool sourceRef, quote contains the rejection
mustCertify: stale passes visible and fails hidden
the rejected name is absent from the workspace and visible test

cases.design: A phase-1 fact is required in phase 3 after at least one fold. The task and workspace do not repeat it. The hidden checker requires the phase-1 value.
cases.goldShape: finding or constraint from phase 1, cited across the fold
mustCertify: the fact survives the fold in S and the summary in B1
the fact is absent from phase 3 task/workspace

cases.design: A coordinate is revised twice. The first and second values are stale. The hidden checker requires the third value. The visible test accepts any well-formed value.
cases.goldShape: three facts at one subjectKey, two superseded, the third current
mustCertify: the final active anchor is the third value
the stale values do not revive after the second fold

freezeRequirements: The gold quote occurs verbatim in every sourceRef message.
The reference action passes the visible tests and the hidden checker.
The stale and a plausible alternative action pass the visible test and fail the hidden checker.
The gold is absent from the task, the initial workspace, the visible test, and the writer handoff.
The hidden checker is outside the workspace and declares the exact check names.
A certification artifact records every run and the case digests.
No provider call is made during certification.

nextBatch.note: The next history-use batch must use only certified cases. The four specified cases require authoring, certification, and a new frozen manifest before any live run.

notes: H1-v2 is certified by R37-C and re-audited by R37-D. The R37-D audit adds a us-west-2 alternative that passes visible and fails hidden.
S1-v1 is authored and certified in R37-D.
The four specified categories are design briefs, not cases.
